newsitem.title: INDIA: India illicit liquor death toll rises to 28.
newsitem.headline: India illicit liquor death toll rises to 28.

text.p: At least 28 people died and more than 40 were admitted to hospital in India's southern Tamil Nadu state after drinking illicit liquor, a police spokesman said on Monday.
An estimated 68 people drank the liquor on Saturday night in Pudukottai district, 350 km (220 miles) from the state capital Madras, the spokesman for Tamil Nadu state police said.

He said illicit liquor tragedies occur frequently in Tamil Nadu because unscrupulous bootleggers add dangerous drugs or potentially poisonous substances to the brew to impart the "kick" their clients seek.
A government official said on Sunday the liquor was mixed with varnish. Police have arrested the owners of the liquor shop and suspended eight policemen for negligence.
